name: periods-hxr-v2
definedBefore: any HXR backtest or result (hxr-prereg-2). Every period of periods-hxr-v1 is unchanged; robustSelection and robustEvaluation were added.

selection.use: compare C1-C3 and the hold; pick one candidate (PREREGISTRATION.md section 8). In-sample.

evaluation.use: one run of the frozen candidate; criteria G1-G6. Overlaps the Strategy Lab's untouched holdout window for MU (disclosed).

fullList.use: reported with the evaluation, not a gate

prospective.start: the first session after the account is started
prospective.use: price rules with timestamped news recorded; criteria P1-P4

robustSelection.use: robustness list, same dates as the selection, every arm; reported only, never used for the pick (PREREGISTRATION-2.md section 5)

robustEvaluation.use: robustness list, same dates as the evaluation, the frozen pick and the hold; reported only, never a gate

excludedSessions.reason: Alpaca has almost no NYSE-listed (Tape A) trades this session; affects VST
Alpaca NYSE trade gap 10:45-15:45 ET for several NYSE names

Alpaca has almost no NYSE-listed trades this session; affects VST

note: Each period starts a fresh US$15,000 account for every arm. Warm-up data before 'start' feeds indicators only. Bars before a symbol's listedFrom (universe-hxr-v1.json) are never used.
